title: Dev order: ship the restored_baseline fallback specified on 2026-04-13
intent: Add a dev order for the automatic refined -> restored_baseline fallback that docs/archive/2026/status/RECOVERY_BASELINE.md specified on 2026-04-13, marked CRITICAL, and whose own status table still reads 'Ship as fallback | PENDING'. The blueprint lane's default extraction has been in a diagnosed regression since f49ead1d (2026-04-12) and the fix was never implemented. Documentation only: the order is written, no code is changed and no implementation is authorized by it.
behavior_change: None. A single new Markdown file under docs/handoffs/. No code, configuration, workflow or test is touched. The order explicitly states it is not an authorization to merge.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds one dev order. It pins the regression to f49ead1d (2026-04-12 15:42, 'feat: hierarchy-based isolation'), carries the April benchmark beside a 2026-09-19 re-run, specifies the fallback at the exact return site, repeats April's do-not-modify constraints verbatim, states the output-size cost up front, and records that D-13 in the forensic report should be re-pointed at this regression rather than carried as a September discovery.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: RECOVERY_BASELINE.md diagnosed the regression but was archived on 2026-05-02 with its Step 2 unimplemented; no order exists asking for it. Verified 2026-09-19 that no automatic refined -> restored_baseline fallback exists anywhere in services/api/app, and that blueprint_async_router.py:147 still defaults to mode='refined'.

commands_run: git log --follow on services/photo-vectorizer/edge_to_dxf.py -> regression window bounded by 86c49526 (2026-04-11 01:41) and f49ead1d (2026-04-12 15:42).
git grep restored_baseline -- services/api/app -> mode is selectable by name only; no automatic fallback exists.

extract_blueprint_to_dxf run with isolate_body True vs False on two production plans, 2026-09-19: Gibson-SG-Custom 16,762 vs 462,053 entities (27.6x); 12 StringDreadnaught_2 12,785 vs 1,071,127 (83.8x).
Rendered both paths for visual comparison: the 12-String refined output is a page border only, reproducing the BORDER_FALLBACK case RECOVERY_BASELINE.md describes.
